object.extractedSnippetText: Topical authority refers to a website's expertise and credibility on a particular subject. It is established by consistently providing high-quality, comprehensive content that covers a full range of related queries within a topic. This helps search engines recognize the site as an expert source, improving rankings and earning audience trust.
